text: {"label":"Vocal Stereotypy and Vocal Repertoires","definition":"Assessment and treatment of vocal stereotypy and scripting, mainly with response interruption and redirection, matched stimulation, or competing items, plus building vocal repertoires, including during augmentative communication use.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets the form and reduction of problematic vocalizations and the expansion of basic vocal output, not intraverbal relations, auditory discrimination, or teaching divergent verbal responses to autistic children."}
